text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After training, while walking through the shopping district with Daring Heart to run errands—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey, is that...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow!
So this is the lottery everyone's talking about!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The usual girls were making a fuss.
Holding a huge pile of pocket tissues, shouting,
"We drew a blank!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In short, it's a test of luck, isn't it?
Sounds like fun♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if I remember correctly...
You just received a ticket, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we can draw it with this.
Yeah, now you can draw it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder if Lady Luck will smile upon me?
Let's go, onsen!
It's showtime!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! It's rattling around!
Go, go, go!♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart happily
turned the lottery wheel crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This is incredible!
It's a hot spring!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, you're making quite a face♪
That just shows how lucky we are!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if even the Goddess can't help but smile
—at someone like me♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Mm-hmm, mm-hmm...
What should we do with that ticket?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A group of us can go, right?
Should I go with Craft and the others, or have fun with another group?
choice_data_list: Looks like it's going to be lively and fun.
Looks like it's going to be lively and fun, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You sound like this doesn't involve you,
but of course you're coming with us!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta share the fun stuff!
We're ride or die...
In this together till the end, right?
choice_data_list: Still, tagging along on a student trip is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see.
You have a point... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: In that case, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't say ASAP.
Once things settle down with the race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the ticket in your care!
Until then—Let's go, training♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is that a carrot stuck
in the hamburger!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: D-Did I spook you? Don't worry, little lady, the taste is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How totally unique!?
Extra toppings for ramen, massive portion sizes...
Japanese people can be pretty daring too, can't they...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, let's dig right in!
Come on, let's go♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~!♪
What an appetizing aroma...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Shall I eat it nice and wild?
Come on, open your mouth wide too!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, nice try!
...A tribute to your boldness!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ready?
――Say 'aah'... Fufu♪"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wow!
A bushel of carrots!
choice_data_list: What should we do? Look at this mountain of work...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Leave it to me.
I have a great idea♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone!
Are you enjoying the BBQ?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There are still plenty of carrots left!
Go ahead and grill 'em up♪

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Heart, you're the best~!" "Wait, there's a whole slab of meat!"
"This is super authentic!" "The carrots are so sweet~♡"
"Trainer, please have some too~♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It was the same back home.
Whenever we got a bunch, we'd just grill 'em and grill 'em!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We're cooking the meat low and slow, so hang in there just a little longer!
Now, let's savor every last bite♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Only one...?
I suppose the Goddess didn't see fit to smile upon me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it!
It might contain some hidden, peerless power, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: In other words, if I eat this...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Super strong!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, thank you♪
Well then, shall we make some carrot sushi
and dig in?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh dear...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Right, so the Goddess of Victory just didn't
smile upon me, huh.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I got dumped.
...Will you comfort me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……You're not going to get flustered anymore?
How boring…… Boooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart seemed disappointed...
Of course, it must be because she lost.
...Let's just blame it on the loss.
